note: Primitive Mendocino National Forest campground at the north-west corner of 20-acre Howard Lake in the Yolla Bolly high country north-east of Covelo, just down the road from Howard Meadow Campground; burned in the 2020 August Complex fire, so watch for fire-damaged trees. A high-clearance vehicle is needed for a creek crossing on the road in. Not maintained in winter. --Claude
